method: each src .kotoba file of every library in docs/upstream-apis.json (and each .kotoba twin of a kami-used namespace found in another library) is written from the kotoba revision's git object to a temporary directory at its lib/ path and checked on its own: `amu check <file>`. The CLI compiles one self-contained file, so a file that requires another module is refused with E6002 rather than checked.
